content:
sarah: quick q — do we bump the patch for config-only PRs if they change default runtime behavior? e.g. flipping `enable_new_cache=true`
aj: depends. is it user-visible or opt-in?
kim: if it changes default for all customers (even behind a flag) then i'd argue yes — it's a behavior change.
aj: +1 for behavior change. if it's purely build metadata or README tweaks, no patch.
sarah: so our rule becomes: docs/chore/no-binary => no patch; default-behavior or change in routing/compat => patch. sounds right?
release-bot: Deploybot check: PR #8723 labelled `config-only`. Automated semver suggestion: keep minor.
sam: hmm Deploybot suggesting minor is noisy. For small default flips i'd prefer patch to avoid implying new features.
mike: can we be more deterministic? propose:
```
- bump patch for: user-facing default changes, routing/compat toggles, runtime flags that alter behavior
- do not bump patch for: logging/text changes, docs, CI config, buildmeta-only
- bump minor for: feature flags toggled on by default AND accompanied by new public API or schema change
```
kim: love this. add: if rollback risk > 0.5 (est), force patch and annotate release notes.
aj: operationally, how do we encode this? label `behavior-defaults` and have releasebot map label -> semver override?
sarah: yes. we can add a `behavior-defaults` label that forces a patch. releasebot already maps `emergency`->hotfix behavior.
release-bot: Note: if `force-patch` label present, deploy pipeline will create tag with `vX.Y.Z+patch` and open release notes draft.
mike: small nit: `+patch` metadata might break some downstream tooling that expects plain semver. maybe use `-patch` prerelease instead (e.g., `v1.2.3-patch1`)
aj: agree. prefer `-patch` pre-release token over buildmeta. lets keep buildmeta for internal only.
sarah: how do we handle backfills / backport branches? backport should mirror semver that the branch originally targeted. if we cherry-pick a default flip into `release-1.2` we should patch-bump 1.2.x and not create a minor.
kim: and release notes: call out the reason: "default toggled for X; considered behavioral change; patched for stability". short and explicit.
sam: one more edge: config only but toggles a latency improvement that could cause downstream overload (throttling). That feels like a risk — patch and require SRE sign-off.
aj: yes, add automation: label `sre-review-required` if change touches `runtime/caching` or `routing/` paths.
sarah: ok i'll open a tiny RFC to document these heuristics and add the `behavior-defaults` label mapping to releasebot.
release-bot: Automation plan: 1) if label `behavior-defaults` or `force-patch` present -> set semver=bump.patch 2) if label `docs-only` or `chore` -> semver=none 3) if label `feature-on-by-default` + api change -> semver=bump.minor 4) if `emergency` -> hotfix flow
mike: logging: when releasebot overrides semver, post a comment in PR explaining reason and include the changelog blurb template.
sarah: thanks team. @aj @kim can one of you add the label-to-semver mapping to the deploybot config? i'll draft the RFC and samples of release note templates. :thumbsup:
